notes.title: Updated 3D system + Bug fixes (Should reload chapter)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
Preparing for additional content, the new update would require to replay/reload the current chapter (the room ids changed, we apologize for the inconvenience). 
Credit for the baseline of the collisions system goes to ColMesh by TheSnidr.
The new update makes the game run faster, offers a much smoother 3D system, better combability for controller support and bug fixes.
Wishing you a pleasant weekend.
Kind regards
DYH

notes.title: Chapter 2: Developers' note
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 
We've been waiting for releasing this chapter for so long! It's so exciting to have the opportunity to release it today. Here are some words of advice for installing the game:
So this chapter requires higher VRAM than the previous (It should be around 1102.03MB, but we wrote 2GB in the requirements to be on the safe side). 
So to make sure people with slow computers (that managed to run Chapters 0&1) can play it, we have created a screen where you'll be able to choose your optimized gameplay:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42452989/0b2eeefe79812d9b4805a81956d5786aa720b428.png[/img]
Try at first to choose advance settings. If it works, the game will save your answer so you'll not have to keep getting this question.
If the game doesn't load and crashes, go back in and choose the average settings.
The game AutoSaves your gameplay and will recognize your progress before you installed the DLC.  
Have a great summer and enjoy!
